div.head: I As 4
div.ab: ⁊ ic wille eac, þæt mine gerefan gedon, þæt man agife þa ciricsceattas ⁊ þa sawlsceattas to ðam stowum þe hit mid rihte togebirige ⁊ sulhælmessan on geare, on ða gerad þæt þa his brucan æt ðam haligum stowum, þe heora cirican began willað ⁊ to Gode ⁊ to me gééarnian willað. Se þe þonne nelle, þolige þare are oððe eft to rihte gecirre.

⁊ ic wille eac, þæt mine gerefan gedon, þæt man agyfe þa cyricsceattas ⁊ þa sawlsceattas to þam stowum þe hit mid rihte togebyrige ⁊ sulhælmessan on geare, on þa gerad þæt þa his brucan æt þam haligan stowan, þe heora cyrcan begán willað ⁊ to Gode ⁊ to me geearnian willað. Se ðe þonne nelle, þolige þære are oððe eft to rihte gecyrre.
Et uolo, ut cyricsceatta reddantur ad eum locum cui recte pertinent, et inde gaudeant in ipsis locis qui hęc dignius erga Deum et nos uolunt deseruire.

⁊ ic wille eac, þæt mine gerefan gedon, þæt man agyfe þa ciricsceattas ⁊ þa sawlsceattas to þam stowum þe hit mid rihte togebyrige ⁊ sulhælmessan on geare, on þa gerad þæt þa his brucan æt þam haligan stowan, þe heora cyrcan begán willað ⁊ to Gode ⁊ to me geearnian willað. Se ðe þonne nelle, þolige þære are oððe eft to rihte gecyrre.

And ic wille eac þæt mine gerefan gedon þæt man agyfe þa cyricsceattas and þa sawlsceattas to ðam stowum þe hit mid rihte to gebyrige and sulhælmessan on geare, on ða gerad þæt þa his brucan æt ðam haligan stowan, þe heora cyrcan began willað and to Gode and to me geearnian willað. Se ðe þonne nelle, þolige þære are oððe eft to rihte gecyrre.

Und ich will auch, dass meine Vögte bewirken, dass man die Kirchensteuern und die Seelschatzungen an jene Stätten gebe, denen es gesetzlich zukommt, und Pflugalmosen jährlich, in der Absicht dass diejenigen dessen geniessen an den heiligen Stätten, die ihrer Kirchen warten wollen und um Gott und um mich sich verdient machen wollen. Wer aber nicht will, verliere die Pfründe oder kehre zum Recht zurück.

And I will also that my reeves bring it about that church-dues and soul-scot are given to those places to which it lawfully belongs, and plough-alms yearly, on the condition that those may enjoy it at the holy places who are willing to serve their churches and to earn merit with God and with me. But whoever will not, let him lose the benefice or return to what is right.

And I further desire that my reeves see to it that church dues and payments for the souls of the dead are rendered at the places to which they are legally due, and that ‘plough alms’ [are rendered] yearly—on the understanding that all these payments shall be used at the holy places by those who are willing to attend to their churches, and wish to gain the favour of God and me. He who is not willing [to attend to his church] shall either forfeit his benefice or revert to a proper discharge of his duties.

And I likewise command my reeves to act so that Church dues and dues for the souls of the dead are paid at the legally designated places, and plow dues each year, on the understanding that they will be used at the holy places by those by those willing to care for their church and who wish to be deserving before God and me. Whoever refuses to do this shall either forfeit his office or resume his proper duties.
div.note: II Eg 2.2; II Eg 5.2; V Atr 7

dues for the souls of the dead . . . plow dues: See notes to The Laws of Edward and Guthrum 6.3 and 5 Æthelred 12. These prescriptions do not occur in the Latin versions of 1 Æthelstan. Both the phrasing and the frequency with which such prescriptions occur in texts associated with Wulfstan make it likely that this passage is a later interpolation by him. Whoever refuses to do this . . . proper duties: Likely a Wulfstanian interpolation.

Nicht der Abgabenpflichtige, für den erstens, wenn er ein kleiner Mann, nicht immer ar als Besitzname zuträfe und zweitens Konfiskation für eine Zahlung bloss an falsche Adresse zu hart wäre; vgl. E Gu 6. Auch nicht (wie Schmid 531, Cohn Justizverweigerung 114 wollen) der säumige Vogt, den vielmehr, laut 5, ‘Ungehorsamstrafe’ trifft; wäre dieser gemeint, so stände ‘sein Amt’. Vielmehr wie in V Atr 7 = VI 4 ist der geistliche Pfründner gemeint; nelle ist der Ggs. zu willað 4 Wörter vorher. — Der Vogt (s. d. Gl 15a), nicht bloss Sheriff (gegen Schmid 597), hilft der Kirche zu ihren Gerechtsamen auch sonst, beaufsichtigt sie aber auch

Not the person liable to pay; for, first, if he were a small man, ar would not always fit him as a term for property, and secondly confiscation would be too harsh for a payment merely made to the wrong address; cf. E Gu 6. Nor (as Schmid 531 and Cohn Justizverweigerung 114 would have it) the negligent reeve, who rather, according to 5, incurs the ‘penalty for disobedience’; if he were meant, the text would read ‘his office’. Rather, as in V Atr 7 = VI 4, the ecclesiastical beneficiary is meant; nelle is the contrast to willað 4 words earlier. — The reeve (see that word in Gl 15a), not merely the sheriff (against Schmid 597), helps the Church to its rights in other respects too, but also supervises it
